response_summary: Verified replacement branch against live main, reconciled historical Issue #57 candidate ancestry, reviewed existing runtime contract/manifest/docs and documented the bounded runtime implementation and acceptance plan.

Hardened Ollama local HTTP access by disabling ambient proxy configuration and rejecting redirects; added proxy and 307 redirect regression tests, documented the boundary, and verified four focused tests plus compilation.

Added a deterministic regression for cancellation while an Ollama-style stream is idle: the request emits a cancelled terminal event and a subsequent independent request still succeeds. Documented the boundary and retained the distinction between fixture coverage and live Ollama server-side cancellation. CI was queued for the tested code revision; results remain pending.

Recorded CI evidence for the cancellation regression: the Tusker AI Runtime Unit Tests workflow passed on the branch's tested code revision, while contract/schema tests and unified validation remained in progress. Updated the implementation plan and PR validation notes without claiming live Ollama server-side cancellation.

summary: Added runtime lifecycle regressions proving the concurrency slot is released after a provider failure and when a consumer closes a partially consumed stream. Updated the implementation plan with successful contract/schema CI evidence and pending latest-head runtime validation.

Branch-head CI caught fixture-only issues in the new runtime slot cleanup tests: fixed request IDs and an always-failing provider fixture. Corrected fixtures so retry requests have matching IDs and the failure occurs only on the first request; rerun CI is active.

Corrected runtime slot-cleanup tests passed on GitHub Actions: runtime unit tests, contract/schema tests, unified validation and PHOENIX manifest integrity all green on code revision 141bcbb52037c25ec8b099c05dea709da5615fef. Subsequent commits update only the implementation plan and log.

Hardened runtime admission cleanup by moving the memory availability probe inside the semaphore try/finally. Added a regression proving a probe exception does not strand the concurrency slot; branch-head CI is pending.

All four required GitHub Actions workflows passed on the memory-probe cleanup code revision: Tusker AI Runtime Unit Tests run 69, PHOENIX release manifest integrity run 240, unified validation run 546, and AI contract tests run 91.
Added an Ollama provider deadline check after each socket read and before processing the returned frame; added a delayed-frame regression test for DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. CI is pending on this revision.

All four required workflows passed on the provider stream-deadline code revision: Tusker AI Runtime Unit Tests run 74, Tusker AI contract tests run 97, unified validation run 562, and PHOENIX release manifest integrity run 256.

Hardened the Ollama stream cancellation boundary: after blocking reads and socket timeouts, cancellation is checked before processing or emitting a frame. Added a delayed-frame regression requiring started/cancelled only.

Bounded Ollama NDJSON frame reads to 1 MiB and validated decoded frame/message object shapes, mapping malformed input to typed provider-disconnected errors. Added oversized and malformed payload regressions; CI pending.

All four required GitHub Actions workflows passed on bounded/malformed stream-frame revision f200ca633bdca9122ea06a406092522fff53f148: Runtime Unit Tests run 82, AI contract tests run 107, unified validation run 583, PHOENIX integrity run 277.

Restricted Ollama endpoint URL shape and bounded/validated version health responses; added regressions for invalid ports, endpoint paths, malformed JSON shapes, invalid version types and oversized bodies. Branch-head CI pending; live Ollama remains NOT RUN.
